nodes.label: Siamese Network Training Curves
nodes.rationale: Two-panel chart (accuracy and loss vs epoch, ~19 epochs) for training and validation sets of a Siamese model. Training accuracy rises 0.56 -> 0.93; validation accuracy plateaus ~0.87-0.88 from epoch ~9. Training loss falls 0.68 -> 0.18; validation loss plateaus ~0.32-0.33 after epoch ~9 with noise. Gap widening after epoch ~8 indicates mild overfitting; early stopping around epoch 9-13 would be appropriate.

nodes.label: Siamese Accuracy Curve (train vs validation)
nodes.rationale: Validation accuracy peaks ~0.878 near epoch 17; train reaches ~0.93.

nodes.label: Siamese Loss Curve (train vs validation)
nodes.rationale: Validation loss stalls ~0.31-0.33 while training loss keeps decreasing to ~0.18: overfitting signal.
